title: Construct Binary Tree from Preorder and Postorder Traversal
constraints: preorder and postorder are permutations of 1..n
Both arrays have equal length and describe at least one valid binary tree.
inputFormat: Implement constructFromPrePost(preorder, postorder). These arrays are valid traversals of the same tree with distinct values.
outputFormat: A root node with val, left, and right fields. Any tree matching both traversals is accepted; the runner displays it as a level-order array with trailing nulls removed.
